versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Minor runtime or metadata adjustments (runtime/run.mjs changed).
- No user-facing feature changes.

- Improved runtime documentation in references/runtime.md for clearer guidance.
- Various internal updates to runtime scripts for enhanced stability.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md to reduce duplication.

- Initial release of yaps-audio-cleaner.
- Cleans speech recordings by reducing noise, hiss, and static using Yaps.
- Supports multiple quality modes: recommended, quick, and maximum, with guidance on when to use each.
- Requires Yaps 2.3.124 or newer; new users must install Yaps and sign in.
- Cleaned audio is saved as a separate file, never overwriting the original.
- Emphasizes validation of output quality and preservation of spoken content.
